summary: A fresh agents roster read waits for one refresh instead of the rest of the refresher's one-second pause, and request latency reports agents reads by fresh, first page and continuation

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, admission, authority or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Agents pages keep the same shape, cut, pagination and 2 s fresh bound. The request-latency routes array keeps its route and work-action rows and adds scope=agents-read rows (read=first-page|fresh|continuation) for GET /v1/client/agents. They are subsets of the route total; do not sum across scopes.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no startup work.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Latency consumers can select scope=agents-read.

recovery.detail: Counters are in memory and reset on restart; a rollback restores the one-second minimum pause for fresh reads and route-only agents latency without changing durable state.
